    [2mDKR-001 · critical · container:coolify/coolify[0m
    [2mrule: [0m[2mPublished container ports do not bypass the host firewall[0m
    [2mfix:  [0mPublish on 127.0.0.1 (127.0.0.1:5432:5432) or the tailnet address, or

          keep a wildcard binding, filter it in DOCKER-USER (for example drop
          new connections on the public interface except from allowed sources),
          or install ufw-docker and open it with a route rule for the sources
          that need it.
